decoder.coordinate_policy: D2 integer-truncated resize and floor pad; clip finite positive raw xyxy to [0,1]; reject zero-area after clipping
decoder.dequantization: signed int8 value × corresponding G0 head int8_scale in float64

heads.layout_view: [anchor=3, entry=10, row, col] over contiguous NCHW channels; channel=anchor*10+entry
heads.name: head13

heads.layout_view: [anchor=3, entry=10, row, col] over contiguous NCHW channels; channel=anchor*10+entry
heads.name: head26

decoder.nms: stable class-wise greedy; threshold then stable score sort then top 15 then NMS; suppress when same-class IoU >= 0.45
decoder.tie_order: head order, row-major cell, anchor-local order, class_id; stable input order for equal scores

limitations: 本证据是 T25 CPU 逐层黄金检测头的 D9 CPU 解码/NMS 参考输出，不含 RTL 检测头逐字节比较。
预测框计数和类别分布不表示模型召回率、分类正确率、mAP 或阶段 2A 通过。
T25 shard 在内存中按索引偏移抽取 head13/head26；其他层张量仅由完整 raw stream SHA-256 绑定，未输出到本证据。
